title: On a phone every tile's date button opens its picker after scrolling
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • You use a phone, or a desktop browser window narrowed to less than 1024 pixels wide (for example about 400 pixels), so the tiles stand in one column.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Dashboard (it opens after you sign in; otherwise tap the menu button and tap Dashboard).
  2. Scroll down to the Sales by Customer tile.
  3. Tap its date button.
  4. Close the picker.
  5. Scroll back up to the Revenue tile and tap its date button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The picker opens next to the Sales by Customer tile.
  • Step 5: The picker opens next to the Revenue tile.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S12-R12 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 13 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet, one rule per defect ticket SV-11246; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14) and S12-N1 (since version 42); read 14 Oct 2026. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.
